title: Sieve and Factorization
statement:
Build the smallest-prime-factor table once, then answer factorization and divisor-count queries.

Input
q, then q lines FACT x or DIV x.

Output
For FACT print the number of distinct prime factors followed by increasing prime/exponent pairs. For DIV print the number of positive divisors. For x=1, FACT prints 0 and DIV prints 1.

Constraints
1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. 1 ≤ x ≤ 1000000.
